description: The contract for generating a page or feature. Missing a required input is a blocking condition, not a guess.

requiredInputs.name: pageGoal
requiredInputs.description: What the user accomplishes on this surface

requiredInputs.name: experienceMode
requiredInputs.description: Determines whether the ai:* namespace is in scope at all

requiredInputs.name: allowedComponents
requiredInputs.description: Resolved from COMPONENTS_INDEX.json; the closed set for this task

requiredInputs.name: brandTokenAvailability
requiredInputs.description: Whether brand-* tokens are defined, per BRAND_THEMING.md

requiredInputs.name: routeOrEmbed
requiredInputs.description: Full page route, panel, or embedded region

requiredOutputs.name: componentList
requiredOutputs.description: Every component id used, in render order

requiredOutputs.name: tokenComplianceReport
requiredOutputs.description: Tokens used; any place a raw value was unavoidable, with reason

requiredOutputs.name: accessibilityChecklist
requiredOutputs.description: Focus order, labels, live regions, contrast, reduced motion

requiredOutputs.name: accountabilityReport
requiredOutputs.description: AI surfaces only: which obligations from ai-interaction.json are satisfied and how

requiredOutputs.name: gapNotes
requiredOutputs.description: Anything requested that the inventory could not supply

instructions: Start from DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md: prefer a full page over a modal when the workflow is multi-step
Select only components present in COMPONENTS_INDEX.json
Apply the BRAND_THEMING.md detection rule before falling back to default shadcn colors
Compose from patterns in /design-system/patterns when one matches the flow

For AI surfaces, choose components whose experienceMetadata.aiBehavior matches the actual autonomy being granted — do not use an Approve-level component for a Suggest-level interaction, or the reverse
blockingConditions: experienceMode is unspecified and the request implies AI behavior
A required component is absent from the inventory and no composition substitutes
The request requires an action with no reversibility or approval path
